directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools, sub-lane slate: every library format beside every concept, the judged fits kept
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: rank-library-formats-against-concepts: a film's format ranking, moved byte for byte

preserve: candidates: every analysed row of INDEX.md's All items (pointers and rows with no folder skipped), the bank's form templates, the person's own formats
concepts: headings, beats, and how many beats are local or in cloud storage
apply refuses a key the catalog does not hold and a concept nobody judged before it writes
format_options, format_palette (options plus plans' picks) and format_ranking_about
allowed_deltas: paths are the request's (library, bank, concept files, package, titles, judged), relative ones in the granted folder
form templates, stable keys, own formats, package ids, skipped concepts, empty options, material wording and the about prose are the person's list:settings row
one JSON result after the printed lines
banned_substitutions: a model score in place of the judges
a film's templates, keys or prose written in code

required_mechanisms: sys.exit(f'refused: keys not in the catalog: {unknown}')

_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
